services.name: Swim Programs
services.desc: Times are reserved throughout the week for adult, teen, and family recreation. Our Recreation Programs are no fee and no advance registration is required (except for adult table tennis). They include badminton, pickleball, table tennis, and more. Check the Margulis gym schedule for a complete listing and the days and times offered. We offer private and semi-private instruction for children, teens, and adults looking to improve their skills in basketball, golf, and tennis. Fitness members have access to +70 group exercise classes that run weekly. Of these, Zumba and Dance classes are maintained in Margulis Gymnasium. Click here to view the full Group Exercise schedule.
